kCc8FmEb1nY.title: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out
kCc8FmEb1nY.creator: Andrej Karpathy

blueprints: We start with self-attention. The core intuition of the transformer attention mechanism is that each token emits queries, keys, and values. The dot product between query and key scaled by square root of head dimension gives the attention matrix.

Residual connections are critical. We take the input x and add it directly to the output of the multi-head attention block: x = x + self.attn(self.ln1(x)). LayerNorm precedes the transformation in modern pre-norm transformers.

During inference, calculating keys and values redundantly for past tokens is computationally wasteful. A KV-cache stores past key and value tensors, transforming generation step complexity from quadratic O(N^2) to linear O(N).

dQw4w9WgXcQ.title: 10 Modern CSS & UI Tricks for S-Tier Web Applications in 100 Seconds
dQw4w9WgXcQ.creator: Fireship

blueprints: Boring static buttons are dead. Modern command palettes and floating bento docks use linear spring physics. Instead of cubic-bezier easing, specify mass, stiffness 170, and damping 26.

For glassmorphism that actually renders at 60fps on mobile GPUs, do not blur giant background surfaces. Use backdrop-filter blur with 12px, coupled with a 1px border gradient with rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08).
Use CSS subgrid inside your Bento grids. It inherits track sizing from parent containers, making multi-card alignments completely automatic without tedious flexbox nesting.
